# #526 — Canon read sends repo:null for non-repo cwds; server rejects it and every such session opens uninjected

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-03T20:23:37Z
Updated: 2026-08-03T20:37:59Z
Closed: 2026-08-03T20:37:59Z

---

## Symptom

Any Claude session whose cwd is not inside a git repo (Buzz-Skippy in `~/.buzz`, plain home-dir sessions) gets ZERO canon — no CANON PACK emissions — on a box where the OB stack is installed and working. This is the real cause of Buzz-Skippy's "empty skull" (the #525 LAN gap applies only off-box; Buzz runs on the dev Mac).

## Repro (live, 2026-08-03, this machine)

```
printf '{"hook_event_name":"SessionStart","source":"startup","session_id":"p","cwd":"/Users/rico"}' \
  | sh ~/.local/share/openbrain-memory/env/openbrain-hook-env openbrain-session-start
# -> WARNING ... SessionStart canon injection failed (OpenBrainToolError); session opens uninjected
```

Same command with `cwd` = an open-brain checkout emits `CANON PACK 1/2` normally. Same env, same server; only cwd differs.

## Cause

`_derive_repo_slug` (#517) correctly returns `None` for a non-repo cwd, and the design says the server should then serve the defined empty state for `repo_facts`. But `_canon_context` (`apps/hooks/session.py:1068-1076`) passes `repo=settings.repo` into `client.agent_context_pack(...)`, which is a pure `**arguments` pass-through (`openbrain-memory client.py:1279`) — so the wire request carries `repo: null`, and the live server rejects the call outright. The whole pack dies, profile/process included, not just repo_facts.

## Fix

Omit the `repo` key when `settings.repo is None` — the pattern the receipts call already uses (`session.py:763-765`: `if repo is not None: arguments["repo"] = repo`). Regression test: fake-transport canon read with a non-repo cwd asserts the request omits the key AND that profile/process sections still inject.
